sloka: अथ लक्ष्मण शत्रुघ्नौ सुमित्रा अजनयत् सुतौ ।वीरौ सर्व अस्त्र कुशलौ विष्णोः अर्ध समन्वितौ ॥१-१८-१४॥
transliteration: atha lakṣmaṇa śatrughnau sumitrā ajanayat sutau ।vīrau sarva astra kuśalau viṣṇoḥ ardha samanvitau ॥1-18-14॥

translations.english: Bharata endowed with pure intellect was born in meena lagna when pushya was in the ascendant. Lakshmana and Satrughna were born in karkata lagna with the star aslesha .
